name: Den
description: Den is Slack/Notion, fully rebuilt for AI agents. It gives you one place for all your chats, docs, and agents.
label: Multiplayer AI agent builder
content_zh: Den 是一个集成了 Slack 和 Notion 功能的平台，专为 AI 代理设计。它为你提供了一个统一的地方来管理所有的聊天、文档和代理。

name: Macaly
description: Macaly is the vibe coding assistant that turns your words into working apps and websites. Just describe your idea by typing or talking, and Macaly builds it instantly. No coding skills needed. Perfect for rapid prototyping, marketers, and non-developers.
label: Apps built by conversations, not code
label_zh: 通过对话构建应用，而非代码
content_zh: Macaly 是一个代码助手，能将你的想法变成实际的应用程序和网站。只需通过打字或语音描述你的创意，Macaly 就会立即帮你构建出来。无需任何编程技能，非常适合快速原型设计、市场营销人员和非开发者使用。

name: Stitch
description: Stitch by Google Labs is a new AI experiment that turns prompts & images into UI designs & frontend code. Leverages Gemini 2.5 Pro, exports to Figma & code.
label: Transform ideas into UI designs
content_zh: Stitch 是 Google Labs 推出的一项新 AI 实验，可以将提示和图片转化为用户界面设计和前端代码。它利用了 Gemini 2.5 Pro，并可以导出到 Figma 和代码。

name: Cua
description: Cua is the Docker for Computer-Use Agent, an open-source framework that enables AI agents to control full operating systems within high-performance, lightweight virtual containers.
label: Docker for computer-use agents
label_zh:
用于计算机的Docker代理

---

根据直译结果重新意译，保持简洁、有力：

适用于计算机的Docker代理
content_zh: Cua 是计算机使用代理的 Docker，它是一个开源框架，能够让 AI 代理在高性能、轻量级的虚拟容器中控制完整的操作系统。

name: Enzzo PM
description: Enzzo is an AI-powered product manager that turns ideas, feedback, and chats into defined products with requirements, competitive insights, structured docs, and tickets—right in the web or inside your Slack. Less time on busywork, more on building.
label: AI-Powered Product Agent: Build Hardware & Software Faster
label_zh: AI驱动的产品代理：更快构建硬件和软件
content_zh: Enzzo PM 是一款由 AI 驱动的产品管理工具，可以将想法、反馈和聊天内容转化为具有明确需求、竞争分析、结构化文档和任务单的完整产品。无论是通过网页还是在 Slack 内部，都能轻松实现。这样你就可以减少繁琐的工作，专注于产品开发。

name: CoffeeHub
description:
CoffeeHub lets you book 1:1 calls with founders, VCs, and experts — like a virtual coffee chat.
No intros, no cold emails. Just pick, book, and connect.

Perfect for startup advice, career tips, or real talk with people you admire.
label: The easiest way to book time with professionals you admire
label_zh: 最简单的方式预约你钦佩的专业人士的时间
content_zh:
CoffeeHub 让你可以直接预约与创始人、投资人和专家的一对一通话，就像虚拟的咖啡聊天。
不需要介绍，也不用发冷邮件。只需选择、预约、连接即可。

非常适合寻求创业建议、职业指导，或者与你敬佩的人进行真实的交流。

name: Canvas AI Builder's Program
description: Got an AI idea but stuck in “demo” mode? Canvas Builders Program is a 2-week, YC-style sprint that turns your rough concept into a live, production-ready agent.
label: YC-style sprint that turns AI ideas into live agents
label_zh: YC风格冲刺，将AI创意转化为实际应用
content_zh: 有AI创意但卡在“演示”阶段？Canvas AI Builder's Program 是一个为期两周的YC风格冲刺项目，能将你的初步想法转化为一个可上线、生产就绪的智能代理。

name: Saina
description:
Saina is an AI Interviewer that helps recruiters filter candidates for faster, unbiased screening. 
⚙️ Pick interview parameters 
🧑🏻‍💻 Saina interviews candidates anytime, all day 
📊Get scores based on set parameters 
⏱ Save resume and phone screening time
label: Filter Top Candidates with AI Interviews ⚡
label_zh: 用AI面试筛选顶尖候选人 ⚡
content_zh:
Saina 是一款 AI 面试官，可以帮助招聘人员更快、更公正地筛选候选人。
⚙️ 选择面试参数
🧑🏻‍💻 Saina 可以全天候随时进行面试
📊 根据设定的参数获取评分
⏱ 节省简历筛选和电话初筛的时间

name: InLabels
description:
Label & DM connections without switching tabs.
🏷️ Unlimited labels to organize inbox.
⚡️ Filter to keep track of chats.
📝 Take notes to remember.
label: Inbox for LinkedIn - Label, Notes & DMs
label_zh: 领英收件箱 - 标签、笔记和私信
content_zh:
标签和直接消息连接，无需切换标签页。
🏷️ 无限标签来整理收件箱。
⚡️ 过滤器跟踪聊天记录。
📝 记笔记以便记住。

name: Voiden API Client
description: Voiden.md is a developer-first API client with local storage, Git-integrated all based on markdown + offline support. Voiden's modular API design and open-source plugins offer flexibility and security without the bloat.
label: Git-native. Modular. Made for devs who build.
label_zh: Git原生。模块化。专为构建者打造。
content_zh: Voiden API Client 是一个以开发者为中心的 API 客户端，支持本地存储和 Git 集成，基于 Markdown 格式并提供离线支持。Voiden 的模块化 API 设计和开源插件提供了灵活性和安全性，同时避免了冗余。

name: Life Note
description:
Life Note is a unique experience where you get personal mentorship from history’s most profound thinkers. Reflect with 1,000 history's boldest thinkers and see how your life can change.

❝ The most life-changing tool! ❞ - Life Note User.
label: Your Mind Meets History’s Greatest Thinkers
label_zh: 你的思想遇见历史上最伟大的思想家
content_zh:
Life Note 是一种独特的体验，让你能够获得历史上最深刻思想家的个人指导。与1000位历史上最杰出的思想家进行反思，看看你的生活会发生怎样的改变。

“最能改变生活的工具！” —— Life Note 用户

name: Routerra
description: Routerra is a fast, user-friendly route planner for couriers, delivery teams, and mobile workers. Use AI to streamline and simplify stop entry from spreadsheets or images, then get optimized routes in seconds — saving time, fuel, and effort.
label: Your AI copilot for delivery route optimization
label_zh: 您的AI副驾，助力配送路线优化
topics_zh:
SaaS

注：SaaS 通常在中文中也直接使用英文缩写，代表“软件即服务”。如果你希望用中文全称，可以翻译为“软件即服务”，但通常情况下保留缩写更为常见。
content_zh: Routerra 是一款快速且用户友好的路线规划工具，适用于快递员、配送团队和移动工作者。它利用 AI 技术简化从电子表格或图片中输入停靠点的过程，并在几秒钟内生成优化的路线，从而节省时间、燃料和精力。

name: Spotify Upcoming Releases Hub
description: The Upcoming Releases hub is a destination solely dedicated to highlighting soon-to-be-released albums powered by Countdown Pages, providing users with a one-stop shop to explore personalized recommendations based on their listening history.
label: A new way for fans to get hyped for new albums
label_zh: 一种让粉丝为新专辑兴奋的新方式
content_zh: 即将发行专区是一个专门用来展示即将发布专辑的平台，通过倒计时页面为用户提供一站式服务，让他们根据自己的听歌历史探索个性化的推荐。

name: Notey
description: Notey is a sleek, intuitive note-taking app designed to help you organize your thoughts,ideas, and tasks seamlessly. Users can mark specific notes as private and secure them with PIN protection,ensuring sensitive content stays safe and accessible only to you.
label: Capture thoughts effortlessly with smart, secure notes
label_zh: 轻松捕捉想法，智能安全笔记随行
content_zh: Notey 是一款简洁直观的笔记应用，旨在帮助你轻松整理思路、想法和任务。用户可以将特定笔记标记为私密，并用PIN码保护，确保敏感内容安全且只有你能访问。

name: Mitsuko
description: AI Subtitle Translator Mitsuko: Get accurate SRT/ASS translations & precise audio transcription. Experience natural, context-aware results in 100+ languages.
label: AI-powered subtitle translator & audio transcription
label_zh: AI驱动的字幕翻译与音频转录
content_zh: Mitsuko：精准的SRT/ASS字幕翻译和音频转录工具。支持100多种语言，提供自然且上下文感知的翻译结果。
